title: Read-only save mounts permit writes
description: MODE_RDONLY is printed but never stored or passed to runtime_file_mount. The file layer protects app0/hostapp only, so saves mounted read-only remain writable.
fix: Store access mode on each mount and enforce it for open/truncate/rename/unlink and metadata writes; return the guest read-only error.
validation: Mount an existing synthetic save MODE_RDONLY; verify all write APIs fail and hashes stay unchanged while reads succeed.

title: Malformed save mount names alias a live slot
description: slot_of uses atoi after the prefix: /savedataX resolves to slot 0. Umount clears slot 0 but unmounts the malformed string, leaving the real file mount behind.
fix: Parse bounded, NUL-terminated decimal text; require a canonical exact /savedataN match before changing state.
validation: Run reproduce_savedata.c; add malformed, trailing-text, missing-digit and unterminated input cases.

title: Save search lists regular files as save directories
description: save_search accepts every suitably named directory entry without checking its file type. A stray.txt fixture increases hits from 1 to 2.
fix: Check directory type with stat/fstatat and define a deliberate symlink policy before collecting entries.
validation: Run reproduce_savedata.c; include a directory, ordinary file, dangling link and metadata sibling.

title: Save deletion returns success when files remain
description: remove_tree discards nftw/removal errors; save_delete unconditionally returns zero. A protected synthetic save retains its child after successful return.
fix: Return and propagate deletion errors, preserve failure details, and serialize deletion against mounts; avoid reporting a removed save until both data and metadata operations have succeeded.
validation: Run reproduce_savedata.c as an unprivileged user; add full permission and mounted-save lifecycle cases.

title: Concurrent save searches race on global sort settings
description: sort_key and sort_order are globals read by qsort's comparator without a lock. Concurrent searches overwrite ordering and introduce a C data race.
fix: Make comparator state per invocation using a portable context sort, or serialize setting state and sorting with a dedicated mutex.
validation: Run concurrent searches with different keys/directions under ThreadSanitizer and verify each independently.

title: Save search dereferences unchecked realloc failures
description: entries=realloc(...) overwrites the only pointer; allocation failure loses the old allocation and immediately dereferences NULL.
fix: Use a temporary pointer, check allocation and capacity overflow, free the prior buffer and return ERR_INTERNAL on failure.
validation: Inject allocation failures at the first and later growth operations; require a guest error and no leaks.

title: Unify Uncharted launch and executable switching across Windows and Linux
description: run.py assumes ctypes.windll and bb-probe.exe; run.sh retains the Bloodborne preparation/patch path, ignores BB_EXE, and has no Uncharted LoadExec loop. Linux output is bb-probe, so the documented Python command in fork discussions does not work on this snapshot.
fix: Introduce a shared platform-neutral runner selecting native filenames, platform-specific wait/console hooks and restart quoting. Route Linux through the same Uncharted per-executable preparation and LoadExec logic; compare with the existing linux branch before duplicating work.
validation: Use synthetic subprocess mocks on both platforms to cover U1/U2/U3, restart, exit 101, paths with spaces and user-directory preservation.

title: Gate macOS delivery on host runtime and Apple Silicon feasibility
description: Direct x86-64 guest execution, Linux arch_prctl/GS, memfd and signal context dependencies have no Darwin backend. Apple Silicon additionally needs an execution/translation strategy. MoltenVK alone cannot supply these CPU/runtime requirements.
fix: Add a clear unsupported-platform configure diagnostic now. Produce separate Intel and ARM feasibility spikes for TLS, fixed mappings, exception handling and Vulkan features before promising playable builds.
validation: Acceptance: documented go/no-go per architecture plus a synthetic guest thread/TLS/memory/fault smoke test; no macOS playable claim until real hardware validation.

title: MP3 and AAC AJM instance requests terminate the entire process
description: instance_create exits(21) for codec!=1 rather than returning an AJM error. Upstream #588 reports this exact MP3 stop on Linux. ATRAC9 is supported; MP3/AAC are not.
fix: Return an explicit unsupported-codec AJM result immediately; add MP3/AAC decoding through an appropriately licensed decoder with correct gapless, partial input, output format and batch semantics.
validation: Request codecs 0/2 using synthetic data: no process exit; later validate decode sample counts and reset/gapless behavior against known fixtures.

title: Replace recursive save wildcard matching with bounded matching
description: like recursively tries every suffix for each percent wildcard. Repeated percent/literal patterns can make save enumeration exponential and deeply recursive.
fix: Use an iterative wildcard algorithm or dynamic programming with bounded pattern length and preserved SQL-LIKE percent/underscore semantics.
validation: Compare results with simple fixtures and benchmark adversarial patterns of increasing length; establish bounded time and stack use.

title: Measure and reduce repeated game preparation in Uncharted runner
description: The Windows preparation cache uses timestamps and repeatedly stats inputs; Linux always prepares/links in the legacy path. There is no shared cache key binding executable identity, module set and preparation version.
fix: After unifying the runner, use an atomic per-game/per-executable manifest keyed by source identity and script/schema version; reuse prepared files only after validation, and invalidate on module additions/removals.
validation: Measure cold and warm launch time and metadata I/O; verify changed source, removed module, interrupted build and same-name games never reuse incorrect artifacts.

title: Add reproducible platform CI and release verification
description: This snapshot has no GitHub Actions workflow; many tests skip unless native test executables exist. A green Python run alone leaves runtime/GPU behavior untested.
fix: Add Windows CLANG64 and Linux dependency-pinned build/test jobs that compile all required harnesses before discovery, fail on unexpected skips, and smoke-test staged packages. Add macOS feasibility-only checks until supported.
validation: CI publishes dependency versions, explicit expected skip list, build/test logs, package manifest, checksums and software-only Vulkan smoke results; hardware playthrough gates remain separate.

title: GPU build fails with Vulkan-Headers 1.4.365
description: ninja -C out/gpu -j2 bbgpu fails with ambiguous vk::Extent2D assignment using GCC and Vulkan-Headers 365. See build.log. Earlier environment setup also failed with older headers missing eMesaKosmickrisp (historical setup evidence, not today's build).
fix: Use explicit vk::Extent2D{width,height} construction at the failing assignment; specify and test minimum/current Vulkan-Headers versions in CMake and CI.
validation: A clean configured Linux build succeeds with documented minimum and current headers; frame-generation extent values remain correct.

title: Investigate U2 streaming assertion reported upstream
description: Open upstream Supermedo/uncharted_pc#479 (also #401/#384/#383) reports iSubMesh < m_numSubMeshInstances. README acknowledges the streaming crash. No causal link to any specific cache bug is proven.
fix: Reproduce at 60 Hz using a legally supplied local dump; bisect memory/cache changes, add bounded resource lifetime and EOP timing diagnostics, then fix the proven ownership or synchronization violation rather than suppressing the assertion.
validation: Affected scene and 30-minute streaming soak pass with cold/warm shader caches; compare save/load and regional revisions.

title: Track U2 chapter 21 progression blocker and physics glitches
description: Open upstream #558/#415/#394 report a truck taking no damage; #448/#590 report ground clipping. These may have different causes and need independent reproductions.
fix: At 60 Hz first, separate projectile/input behavior from timestep and collision problems; bisect game timing patches and restore validated timing for affected revisions. Keep separate failing assertions for truck progression and collision.
validation: Replay chapter 21 from a local save and verify truck damage, progression and stable collisions at supported 30/60 Hz.

title: Track U3 missing geometry and view-blocking graphics corruption
description: Open upstream #601/#603/#356/#376 report missing objects and corrupt geometry. Existing fork #31/#37 cover specific code defects but are not demonstrated root causes of these reports.
fix: Capture a bounded renderer trace on affected hardware, compare with AA off, validate cache barriers and shader IR, and apply existing cache/recompiler fixes one at a time with visual verification.
validation: Affected U3 early chapters render climbable geometry consistently across AMD/NVIDIA; attach diagnostic text and reference observations, not game assets.

title: Investigate U3 video freezes while audio advances
description: Open upstream #510 reports frozen video with continuing audio, including recurrence at 60 FPS.
fix: Instrument decode return codes, packet/frame progress and presentation timestamps; test decoder flush/drain and reset paths; fix the demonstrated stall while preserving audio/video synchronization.
validation: Multiple affected cutscenes complete at 60 Hz after pause/resume and scene changes; decode errors return explicit guest errors.

title: Fix Steam shortcut process association for Windows launcher
description: Open upstream #362 reports Steam Input selecting desktop bindings when shortcuts target Play Uncharted.exe, while a direct bb-probe.exe shortcut works. Fork #20 is related Linux device routing, not the same Windows launch path.
fix: Generate a prepared direct-game shortcut with validated arguments/environment, or retain correct Steam association through launcher process lifetime; document preparation invalidation after updates.
validation: Test Steam Controller and Xbox controller through Game Mode and Desktop Mode shortcuts, with fresh preparation and after an update.

title: Accept validated decrypted ELF inputs or explain required SELF format
description: Open upstream #498 supplies the error expected PS4 SELF for already decrypted plain ELF input. parse_self explicitly rejects the ELF magic.
fix: Add a validated ELF64 x86-64 input path sharing all segment/bounds checks with SELF extraction, including module-linking callers; alternatively document the supported dump format clearly without asking users to share binaries.
validation: Synthetic plain ELF and equivalent SELF yield consistent images; reject malformed program headers, filesz/memsz overflow, wrong architecture and truncated segments.
